activity.notes: Clovis I is recorded as Merovingian King of the Franks from 481 to 511. ATLAS uses the contemporary Frankish polity rather than retrojecting the later Kingdom of France.

sources.title: Clovis I, King of the Franks — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Clovis I as Merovingian King of the Franks and gives his reign as 481-511.
